data.one_liner: Translate integers to Roman numerals and Roman numeral strings to integers in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides Dart extensions to translate decimal integers to Roman numerals and validate or parse Roman numeral strings back to integers. Supports multiple configurations such as common, vinculum, apostrophus, and compact apostrophus styles.
use_when: You need to format numbers as Roman numerals in your Dart or Flutter application.
You need to parse or validate Roman numeral strings.
avoid_when: You require support for negative numbers or complex non-standard formats out of the box.
strengths: Supports multiple Roman numeral configuration styles including common, vinculum, and apostrophus.
Provides string validation and custom zero (nulla) placeholder support.
weaknesses: Compact apostrophus styles require fonts that support specific Unicode characters.
